findings.title: Reentrancy in unstake() allows attacker to steal ether from other stakers
findings.offending_expression: (bool ok, ) = msg.sender.call{value: amount}(""); require(ok, "eth transfer failed"); totalStaked -= amount; stakeOf[msg.sender] = 0;

patch.label: 修補已通過驗證（針對此攻擊）
patch.rationale: Reordered state updates before the external call, following checks-effects-interactions pattern, to eliminate the reentrancy bug in unstake().

note: 已證實可攻擊的判定附可重跑的攻擊證據；其他判定都不代表合約沒有漏洞。
